text:
sasha: Quick q — trying to point the Node SDK at a private endpoint behind our corp proxy. baseUrl=https://inference.internal.redwood. Getting ECONNRESET when starting streaming.
raj: Which Node version + how are you configuring proxy? are you using HTTPS_PROXY or passing an httpsAgent?
sasha: Using node 18.14, set HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:3128
sasha: SDK config:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: 'https://inference.internal.redwood', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, httpsAgent: new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTPS_PROXY) });
client.chat.stream(...)
```
mike: Two things: corporate proxies that terminate TLS will break streaming unless the client tunnels via CONNECT. tunnel-https / https-proxy-agent both support that but you must pass the agent to the underlying http library we use. Also for mTLS client certs you need to attach cert/key on the agent (agentOptions.cert/key). Example:
```js
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ hostname: 'proxy.corp', port: 3128, rejectUnauthorized: true, cert: fs.readFileSync('./client.pem'), key: fs.readFileSync('./client.key'), ca: fs.readFileSync('./ca.pem') });
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: 'https://inference.internal.redwood', httpsAgent: agent });
```
mike: If the proxy is doing TLS-termination you must use CONNECT/tunnel. env var alone sometimes yields plain forward proxy behavior which breaks SNI.
anna: Also check hostname used in baseUrl matches the cert SAN on the internal LB. If they differ, SNI mismatch -> TLS reset. Use proper internal DNS name.
raj: For retries: streaming endpoints won't auto-retry mid-stream. We only retry on idempotent requests (embeddings, non-stream generation) with 502/504. For chat streaming you'll need client side reconnect logic + resume using conversation prefix.
mike: FYI Go SDK had a proxy+streaming bug fixed in v0.8.2 — update if you saw similar in Go.
sasha: Awesome, I'll try configuring HttpsProxyAgent with certs + ensure baseUrl matches SAN. Will report back. Thanks :party_parrot: 
cli-bot: config-change: sandbox network proxy updated to allow CONNECT to inference.internal.redwood (by @mike)
